Keypad mode: the bar shows 4 of 6 shaded and grading is exactString, so a kid who types the equally correct 2/3 is marked wrong; wording like "How many parts out of how many are shaded?" would make the expected form explicit.

The number line is labelled in rounded decimals (0, 0.3, 0.7, 1) on a question whose answer must be the fraction 1/3 — wrong notation and numerically false (1/3 ≠ 0.3), and the "0.3" label sits directly under the marked dot, so reading the diagram literally gives 0.3 or 3/10; NumberLineSpec has no fraction-label option.
